subject: OrbitBank: SOC 2 / SIG evidence request — CVE remediation attestations and artifacts
messages:
From: OrbitBank Security <security@orbitbank.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: SecureScan Reports <reports@securescan.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Aug 2028 10:03:22 -0400
Subject: SOC 2 / SIG evidence request — CVE remediation attestations and artifacts

Hi Rafael,

We're preparing for our SOC 2 scoping review and SIG submission next week. Our security team needs a consolidated packet showing recent vulnerability remediation for any CVEs that were closed in the last 90 days affecting our tenant. Specifically, please provide: 

- A signed attestation for each CVE that confirms remediation (who owned the fix, PR link, date deployed)
- Scan snapshot that demonstrates the vulnerability is no longer present (full scanner output or filtered CSV)
- Deploy proof (minimal logs or package version) and rollback / mitigation notes if applicable
- Expected SLA for similar critical/high CVEs going forward (SLA window and escalation path)

We'd prefer a single ZIP with an index, but distinct PDF attestation(s) signed by an authorized Redwood rep is required for our audit evidence. Deadline: COB 2028-08-21.

Can you confirm scope and what you can deliver by that date?

Thanks,
Jill Patel
Security Program Manager
OrbitBank

---
Attachment: orbitbank-scan-ask-20280817.pdf (pdf)
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: OrbitBank Security <security@orbitbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Aug 2028 11:28:10 -0400
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG evidence request — CVE remediation attestations and artifacts

Hi Jill — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide the packet by the deadline. Proposed deliverables: 

1) Per-CVE attestation PDF (signed) covering: CVE ID, remediation owner, PR(s), deploy date & environment, short remediation note.
2) Scan snapshot CSV exported from SecureScan filtered to the OrbitBank tenant for the relevant dates (we will include the full CSV and a filtered view).
3) Deploy proof: link to PR, a short deploy log snippet (timestamp + deployed version), and the orchestration job ID.
4) SLA statement (critical / high: 30 / 60 days target for typical infra CVEs; immediate escalation for exploitable remote code execution). We'll include escalation contacts.

Karthik, Marissa — looping you in for the technical attachments and signed attestation. Karthik, can your team pull the scanner export and attach the remediation PR/patch files? Marissa, can you prepare the attestation and signoff (PDF)?

Rafael
Director, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks Rafael — quick technical note on artifacts we'll include: 

- vm-scan-20280801.csv (full SecureScan export for 2028-07-01 -> 2028-08-16 window)
- cve-2028-4512-fix-pr-1234.patch (patch / PR diff from our repo)
- cve-2028-4512-deploy-log.txt (timestamped container deploy stdout, limited to header lines showing image digest + deploy job id)
- remediation-matrix.csv (CVE -> owner -> PR -> deployed? -> notes)

For attestation content, please confirm if OrbitBank requires a named signatory with title (e.g., VP/CISO on our side) or if a Director-level signature is acceptable. Also note that for third-party library CVEs we will include the upgrade PR and a short risk note if a full backport couldn't be applied (and any compensating controls).

Jira: I created RDW-7892 to track the artifact collection and exports.

Karthik
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks — a couple clarifications: 

- For SOC 2/SIG we need the attestation signed by an authorized Redwood officer (Director is fine, CISO/VP preferred). A PDF with an embedded signature or a DocuSign envelope is acceptable.
- Please include the exact timestamps (UTC) of deploy logs for audit mapping.
- Where a library upgrade was used, include the exact released version and the checksum if available.

Deadline remains COB 2028-08-21. If you can provide an interim bundle (attestation draft + scanner CSV) by EOD 2028-08-18 that would help us start review.

Regards,
Jill Patel
